source_text.body:
Build a WordPress marketing site from Figma overnight
bnistordev connected Devin to a Figma file via MCP and had it build an entire WordPress marketing site overnight.
·
Sep 29, 2026
Done with
DE
Devin
What they did
bnistordev gave Devin AI access to the Figma file for the new marketing site via MCP. The agent then built the full WordPress frontend plus content management features on its own overnight.
How it went
Output quality matched work he would quote €2.5k for, though the site is still unfinished.
Worth knowing
It ran overnight but needed later human review to complete.
Try it yourself
with
Devin
Copy prompt
Using my Figma file [Figma link] through MCP, build a complete WordPress marketing site with pages [list pages], matching the design. Set it up in [local or staging environment] and finish when every page renders and matches the Figma layout. Show me the result before anything goes to a live site.
Original source: https://x.com/bnistordev/status/2104882458671907327
source_text.scope: Captured case text; external linked articles and HTML excluded.
